text.p: Schnitzer Steel Industries Inc said Monday it is "evaluating other possible business acquisitions."
The company did not specify what other acquisitions it was evaluating.
Schnitzer has proposed to acquire Proler International Corp and last year acquired Manufacturing Management Inc.
The company today reported lower fourth quarter net income.
"Although shipments by both Scrap and Steel Operations were higher than last year, the results for the year reflected lower average selling prices," said Robert Philip, president.

"We believe that the fundamentals of the scrap industry are sound and we will continue to pursue strategic acquisitions of other scrap companies. Manufacturing Management Inc acquired in March of 1995, has proven to be a definite complement to our West Coast operations and we are very excited about our pending acquisition of Proler International Corp." The company added it also is "evaluating other possible business acquisitions."
